limits: 29, 40, 60 and 80 degrees Celsius are solution temperatures, not measured electrode temperatures; missing solution volumes and run endpoints remain unknown.
Only the two text-supported powder outcomes at 29 and 80 degrees Celsius qualify in the current broad-pair projection. Intermediate-temperature graph estimates remain inferred.
Generic TEM, size-distribution and BET observations are accessible source context without an invented exact temperature or batch assignment.
Sintering procedures, the purchased Cerac comparator and the Ce-free electrolyte control remain separate supporting contexts, not new primary preparation routes.
Sintered grain size, particle size and diffraction crystallite size retain their distinct measurement bases.
The 1250 degrees Celsius prose/plot density disagreement and proposed electrochemical mechanism remain explicitly qualified.
The purchased comparator has a separate identity card and provenance from electrochemically prepared powder; no commercial production recipe is invented.
No source-supplied atomic coordinates or new training-eligibility exception are admitted.
